notes: Column numbers are estimated from the breadboard image (LED/resistor columns 7, 10, 13, 16, 19, 22; cathode in the next column). Exact holes may differ slightly.

The breadboard catalogue names bank 't' as rows a-e and 'b' as rows f-j; the image's lower half (rows a-e) is therefore bank 't' and the upper half (f-j, where the LEDs sit) is bank 'b'. The top rail next to the LEDs is named 'bn' accordingly; rail hole numbers are approximate and any hole on the strip is electrically equivalent.

Wiring: Uno pins 7,6,5,4,3,2 each go through a blue jumper to a 220 ohm resistor that spans the centre gap, then to the LED anode; each LED cathode goes via a short black jumper to the ground rail, which connects to the Uno GND by a black wire (GND.1 assumed for the header GND next to AREF).
The manual's text says 6 220 ohm resistors; the schematic confirms 220 ohm. The LED order in the sketch array (2,7,4,6,5,3) is software only and does not affect wiring.
